recipes.oracle_text:
Flying
This creature can block only creatures with flying.

recipe_coverage: Reviewed unconditional blocking restriction component: Oracle stats and casting costs, exact/wrong-color/missing payment, ground and flying attackers across power boundaries for both players, Reach as distinct from Flying, tapped and summoning-sick blockers, real pre-block power changes, declared blockers and combat damage, cleanup, populated/empty zones, and snapshot replay after AI backups. Untested activated abilities, Flash timing, forced attacks, control changes, multiple attackers/blockers, and other keyword combinations remain gaps. Component coverage, not whole-card certification.
